content.content: 1. Necessity: the dependent needs the undo promise and the redo promise for restoring an operation boundary — without them, bounding undo and redo is motiveless. Fail if either edge can be dropped without loss; name the dropped edge. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Scope is where the boundary meets the restoration; the gate keeps the use sound without testing granularity itself.
